VERDICT: ISSUES
1. `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/_work_item_common.py:~380`: the widened guard lets every `WorkflowError` subclass through, but only three are mapped. The others hit the old fallback, which raises a generic `JsonRpcError(-32602, "work item error", code='work_item_error')`. Those subclasses are `WorkflowNotFoundError`, `WorkflowPermissionDeniedError`, `StageConflictError`, `KindNotAllowedError`, `WorkflowAlreadyActiveError` and similar. Later tools (WP2-T4 to T8) expect "not found -> -32602" and "perm -> -32603". For example, a permission denial would surface as -32602 with a misleading code. The acceptance only requires the three mappings, so this is not a T1 failure, but it is a trap for the dependent tasks. It needs either a mapping or a documented deferral. The new tests don't cover it.

The rest matches the acceptance. The 13 output models are present, `WorkItemWithMovesOutput` subclasses `WorkItemOutput` with the four added fields, and `ProposeMoveOutput` has `awaiting_signoff`. The tests cover the three mappings and the `ValueError` propagating unchanged. I did not run the tests.
